zh-TW.title: 反向眼跳抑制（Antisaccade）
zh-TW.description: 方塊在一側閃現時改看另一側，趁花紋蓋住前看出箭頭指向左、上或右，練習不被突然出現的東西拉走視線。

en.title: Antisaccade
en.description: When a square flashes on one side, look to the other side and name the arrow's direction before a pattern covers it. Practice keeping your eyes from jumping to sudden movement.
